filename: T2 - Pilocytic astrocytoma cerebellopontine angle , ventricle 006.jpg
description: Contrast-enhanced MRI demonstrating a well-defined heterogenous and peripherally enhancing multilobulated thick-walled tumor with a small cystic center within the left cerebellopontine angle. The mass abuts the cisternal seventh and eighth cranial nerves and their nerve root entry zone. This appears to have mass effect on the fourth ventricle, and adjacent dural enhancement.
